机制概述: Lucida has 4 double-sided Rend/Consume Tokens. When she hits the opponent, she gains a Rend Token, which automatically applies its effects next beat. The Rend Token then becomes an Ingest Token, which can be used on a future turn to empower Lucida.

效果.效果: Setup: Deplete all Rend/Consume Tokens and place them with their Rend side up.
<o-b>Limited Ante:</o-b> Use a <i-sb>Consume Token</i-sb>, and flip it to its <i-sb>Rend</i-sb> side as you deplete it.
Reveal: Apply the effects of all Rend Tokens to the Opponent, then flip those tokens to their Consume side.
